Key of Inspiration.enDesc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the Meditative Scholars. Used to level up Traces slightly for Erudition characters.

Key of Knowledge.enDesc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the sages of the worlds. Used to level up Traces moderately for Erudition characters.

Key of Wisdom.enDesc: A mythical key that appears in the hands of the greatest prodigies of the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for Erudition characters.

Shattered Blade.enDesc: Weapon fragments left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces slightly for Destruction characters.

Lifeless Blade.enDesc: Weapon fragments left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces moderately for Destruction.

Worldbreaker Blade.enDesc: Broken weapon left behind by members of the Antimatter Legion. Used to level up Traces significantly for Destruction.

Arrow of the Beast Hunter.enDesc: An arrowhead forged with Frost Steel by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces slightly for Hunt characters.

Arrow of the Demon Slayer.enDesc: An arrowhead forged with Stellaris Essence by the craftsmen of Xianzhou. Used to level up Traces moderately for Hunt characters.

Arrow of the Starchaser.enDesc: A shard of the Sky-Shattering Lux Arrow shot by the Reignbow Arbiter. Used to level up Traces significantly for Hunt characters.
sources: Calyx (Crimson): Bud of The Hunt (Outlying Snow Plains)

Tears of Dreams.enDesc: Sealed thoughts and feelings. Can substitute Path Materials when they are insufficient. The substitution ratio of Tears of Dreams varies depending on the materials' rarity.
sources: Increase Synchronicity Level of Divergent Universe

Lupitoxin Sawteeth.enDesc: Blood-sucking sharp fangs left behind during the borisins' conquests. Used to level up Traces moderately for Destruction characters.

Borisin Teeth.enDesc: Broken teeth fragments left behind during the borisins' conquests. Used to level up Traces slightly for Destruction characters.

Moon Rage Fang.enDesc: Terrifying tusks left behind during the borisins' conquests. Used to level up Traces significantly for Destruction.

Countertemporal Shot.enDesc: A spiral bullet forever going against the arrow of time, like a hound eternally chasing the immortal that defies time. Used to level up Traces significantly for The Hunt characters.

Destined Expiration.enDesc: Embedded in the deceased's brow, piercing through the crevice of matter, this bullet forever resides where its bullet hole should be. Used to level up Traces moderately for The Hunt characters.

Meteoric Bullet.enDesc: Iron pellets forged for hunting monsters. Each one bears scratches that seem to record the number of prey that perished because of it. Used to level up Traces slightly for The Hunt characters.

Rough Sketch.enDesc: A Clockie sketch that outlines the shape of a dream with a few strokes. Used to level up Traces slightly for Erudition characters.

Grit of Strife.enDesc: Crimson crystal dust that Castrum Kremnos craftsmen use to coat their weapons. Slightly increases the Traces of The Hunt characters.

Resin of Valor.enDesc: Crimson crystal amber forged by the craftsmen of Castrum Kremnos while tempering weapons. Moderately increases the Traces of The Hunt characters.

Lance of Retribution.enDesc: A crimson spear forged from the lives and dignity of the craftsmen of Castrum Kremnos. Greatly increases the Traces of The Hunt characters.

Endurance of Bronze.enDesc: A crude but durable ancient hand-held bronze shield. Used to level up Traces slightly for Preservation characters.

Harmonic Tune.enDesc: A compact music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces slightly for Harmony characters.

Oath of Steel.enDesc: A shield forged with irreplaceable craftsmanship from an unknown alloy. Used to level up Traces moderately for Preservation characters.

Safeguard of Amber.enDesc: An unusual shield embedded with ambers mined from beyond the skies. Used to level up Traces significantly for Preservation characters.

Ancestral Hymn.enDesc: A music box made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces moderately for Harmony characters.

Stellaris Symphony.enDesc: A music box with complex structures made by an unknown person. Used to level up Traces significantly for Harmony characters.

Obsidian of Dread.enDesc: A fragment of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces slightly for Nihility characters.

Obsidian of Desolation.enDesc: A chunk of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces moderately for Nihility characters.

Obsidian of Obsession.enDesc: A sizable piece of dark matter captured from the void. Used to level up Traces significantly for Nihility characters.

Fiery Spirit.enDesc: Feeble heliobus that scattered after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces slightly for Nihility characters.

Starfire Essence.enDesc: A mature heliobus that ran away after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces moderately for Nihility characters.

Heaven Incinerator.enDesc: A beast-form heliobus that homogenized after the Flaming Catastrophe War. Used to level up Traces significantly for Nihility characters.

Firmament Note.enDesc: Scattered note from the firmament. Used to level up Traces slightly for Harmony characters.

Celestial Section.enDesc: Melodious section fallen from the heavens. Used to level up Traces moderately for Harmony characters.

Heavenly Melody.enDesc: Symphonic movements from the cosmos. Used to level up Traces significantly for Harmony characters.

Divine Amber.enDesc: The amber that rains from the Amber Lord's body when THEY swing the celestial hammer. Used to level up Traces significantly for Preservation characters.

Dynamic Outlining.enDesc: A Clockie outlint drawing that clearly depicts the silhouette of a dream upon paper. Used to level up Traces moderately for Erudition characters.

Exquisite Colored Draft.enDesc: A colored drawing of Clockie that brings the dream to life with vibrant colors. Used to level up traces significantly for Erudition characters.

Seed of Abundance.enDesc: A seed of blessing sown by the Aeon of Abundance. Used to level up Traces slightly for Abundance characters.

Flower of Eternity.enDesc: A gorgeous flower blooming from the Sprout of Life. Used to level up Traces significantly for Abundance characters.

Sprout of Life.enDesc: A young sprout emerging from the Seed of Abundance. Used to level up Traces moderately for Abundance characters.

sources: Echo of War: End of the Eternal Freeze

sources: Echo of War: Borehole Planet's Past Nightmares

Alien Tree Seed.enDesc: The seed obtained from the fruit of the heart tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest, carrying the genes of various life forms. Used to level up Traces slightly for Abundance characters.

Myriad Fruit.enDesc: The fruit grown on the tip of the heart tree's branch in the sacred Vonwacq forest. It contains the essence of myriad lifeforms. Used to level up Traces significantly for Abundance characters.

Nourishing Honey.enDesc: The nectar brewed from the juice of flowers growing on the heart tree in the sacred Vonwacq forest. A honey that can accelerate the growth of life. Used to level up Traces moderately for Abundance characters.

sources: Echo of War: Salutations of Ashen Dreams

Bīja of Consciousness.enDesc: Consciousness fuses with matter, giving rise to the embryo of memory. Used to level up Traces slightly for Remembrance characters.

Flower of Ālaya.enDesc: This is another form for life to exist and a substance that the universe cannot forget. Used to level up Traces significantly for Remembrance characters.
sources: Calyx (Crimson): Bud of Remembrance ("Strife Ruins" Castrum Kremnos)

Seedling of Manas.enDesc: Memory's cells extract thoughts, propagating in the heart of the inscriber. Used to level up Traces moderately for Remembrance characters.
sources: Calyx (Crimson): Bud of Remembrance ("Strife Ruins" Castrum Kremnos)
